summary: First Phosphate Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a Notice of Change of Status under NI 51-102, advising Canadian securities regulators that, effective August 10, 2026, it ceased to be a venture issuer because its American Depositary Receipts were listed on the Nasdaq Global Market. This is a routine regulatory status change notification, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, transactions, or strategic actions were involved.
